summary: Implemented Ledger.total: sum of tenant's approved entries, rounded to 2dp half away from zero (DF-FXL-0007).

criteria.criterion: Approved 0.005 alone totals 0.01; approved -0.005 alone totals -0.01.
criteria.test: total rounds approved 0.005 to 0.01 and -0.005 to -0.01

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count.
criteria.test: total ignores unapproved and other tenants entries

summary: Implemented Ledger.approve per RQ-FXL-0004 check order using FxIdentity.isActive/hasRole, plus accepted amendment RQ-FXL-0104 (amount > 10000 needs Approver and Admin, after NotFound, before SelfApproval).

criteria.criterion: A session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve; at 15 minutes 1 second it gets SessionExpired.
criteria.test: approve session idle exactly 15 minutes can approve; approve session idle 15 minutes 1 second is SessionExpired

criteria.criterion: An Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized.
criteria.test: approve Admin without Approver is NotAuthorized

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0104: An Approver without Admin approving an entry of 10,000.01 gets NotAuthorized.
criteria.test: approve high value 10000.01 needs Admin too

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0104: An entry of exactly 10,000 needs only Approver.
criteria.test: approve entry of exactly 10000 needs only Approver

summary: Implemented Ledger.view: SessionExpired if inactive (via isActive), else entries of session tenant in original order; no role widens it.

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries.
criteria.test: view Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries in order

summary: Not implemented. Package INCOMPLETE: RQ-FXL-0008 is proposed, DF-FXL-0009 (rates source) is draft with no decision and no rates available; RQ-FXL-0008 has no acceptance criteria; rounding and rate date unspecified.
